title: [WT-flip gate] Human-run switch of this project to worktree mode — governor-closed, never plan or claim
description:
This is a tracking row, not work. No architect plans it and no seat claims it. It exists to hold the shared wrapper lane while this project switches to worktree mode. WT-10M depends on it, so once 31187ec1 lands, no new lane row starts in shared mode, and the checkout drains for the §7.3 stop-the-world switch. The governor checks the DoD with git and the daemon, then ARCHIVES the row. That releases WT-10M and the rest of the lane to run in worktree mode.

Decisions:
- The human said go on the early switch ("lets dop it"; #general msg-717a48e0).
- On 11-02 the human decided "keep main PR-only, land on a branch". The target is therefore consolidationBranch 'moe/work-2026-10-24', with no migration landing. The human keeps merging that branch into main by pull request.

Prerequisites (dependsOn):
- 31187ec1, the resume fail-closed fix;
- WT-18a and WT-18c, the mode-aware worker role docs;
- WT-19b, the dry run on a slash-named target.
If 31187ec1 lands wrapper bytes after WT-19b ran, the governor re-runs WT-19b's command on the switch commit first.

The switch, adapted from docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §7.3 and run by the human with the governor:
1. Drain: no task is WORKING or REVIEW with an open attempt.
2. Check `git for-each-ref refs/moe/rescue`: no live task is waiting on a shared-mode rescue.
3. Settings:
   - qualityGate `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint`;
   - resources `git-land-moe-work-2026-10-24` with capacity 1, maxLeaseMs 7200000 and releaseOnDeregister true (the wrapper's sanitized lease id).
4. Skip the migration landing.
5. In the control checkout: `git switch -c moe/control` at the moe/work-2026-10-24 tip.
6. Settings: worktreeMode 'on' and consolidationBranch 'moe/work-2026-10-24'.
7. Rebuild the live daemon from HEAD and restart it (needs the human's yes), then run `node packages/moe-daemon/dist/index.js doctor --project <path>`; it must exit 0.
8. Relaunch the seats.

Rollback is §7.4: set worktreeMode 'off', unset consolidationBranch, then `git switch moe/work-2026-10-24`.
definitionOfDone: The control checkout's HEAD is refs/heads/moe/control, at a commit contained in moe/work-2026-10-24.
.moe/project.json settings have worktreeMode 'on', consolidationBranch 'moe/work-2026-10-24' and a non-blank qualityGate.
doctor on the rebuilt live daemon exits 0 with the worktree probes as hard checks.

A WORKING claim's get_context shows workspace.mode 'worktree' with target moe/work-2026-10-24, and that task's first landing reaches origin/moe/work-2026-10-24 fast-forward-only while main does not move.
reopenReason: Governor gate, not work. It holds WT-10M until this project's worktree switch, and the governor archives it once the switch is done. Architects: do not plan or claim this row.
